intro: Crystal Kelp Fronds are aquatic plant cuttings gathered from the murlocs inhabiting Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest. Though native to the ocean, murlocs carry fronds inland, making them an unusual alchemical reagent sought after by William Pestle in Goldshire.

p: Crystal kelp typically thrives in the depths of saltwater oceans, making its presence in the freshwater pools of Elwynn Forest unexpected. The murloc tribes settled along the shores of Crystal Lake gather and hold onto these fronds for reasons of their own. Alchemists value the fronds for their peculiar visual-distorting properties, and William Pestle in Goldshire specifically uses them as the core ingredient in an invisibility liquor designed to help clandestine sweethearts slip past watchful family eyes.
